name: Stillwater
coreSense: Wide availability persisting, open and silent, with nothing arriving and nothing changing.
image: The channel is open and has been open for a while. Nothing is arriving. No specific source has claimed your attention, no signal has broken the silence. The availability itself is stable, held without strain. A harbor in flat weather: the water is real, the depth is real, the readiness is real. No ships are coming in. You're simply present to the field, not waiting for anything in particular. The situation isn't moving. This is what it is right now, an open, unhurried space that is its own kind of fullness.

name: Preface
coreSense: Open silent availability beginning to orient toward expression, receptivity tilting into readiness to send.
image: You've been open to whatever came, with no particular agenda, no specific source filling you. Something in that wide, patient receiving has started to shift. The orientation is turning. No message has formed yet, but the posture is changing from available-to-receive to available-to-reach-out. A stage being set before anyone knows what the performance will be. The infrastructure of expression is coming online, the network, the reach, the capacity, held silently, pointing outward without yet having anything to say.

name: Sighting
coreSense: Wide undirected availability narrowing to a pointed vigil, something specific worth attending to has emerged from the silence.
image: The wide, open listening has caught something. Out of the general availability, no focus, no target, just readiness, one frequency has come forward. Nothing has arrived yet. The attention is narrowing now, drawn toward one specific source. A naturalist pausing mid-walk, suddenly alert to a particular corner of the forest. The scan is over. The tuning has begun. You're holding the channel open in one direction now, configured to catch whatever this particular source will send.

name: Resolve
coreSense: Open, objectless availability crystallizing into a specific directed intention, silence becomes purpose.
image: Something has formed in the silence. The wide open availability, receiving nothing, aimed at nothing, has been a kind of gestation. Now a direction is emerging: an intention taking shape, an antenna being pointed at one specific target. The nocked arrow hasn't left the bow yet. The intention is real and aimed at something particular, but no action has been taken. What was empty receiving is becoming focused, directed, latent purpose, the silence that precedes a specific move.

name: Influx
coreSense: Passive open availability activating into wide intake, the silence starts filling from many directions.
image: The channel was open and empty, available but not receiving, waiting on nothing in particular. Now input is arriving, and it's arriving from everywhere at once. The availability that was passive has become active: things are coming in, signals from many directions, a rush of data that hasn't been sorted yet. Reading the room after the room has finally started talking. Nothing is being filtered, nothing committed to. The value right now is in the breadth of what's arriving. The wide aperture that was held open for its own sake has found what it was configured for.

name: Emergence
coreSense: Wide empty receptivity reversing into wide active sending, silence turns outward.
image: The open availability has been entirely inward, wide, unfocused, taking nothing in, asking nothing of anyone. Now the direction is reversing. The same distributed, wide-open posture is becoming outward: signals going out across a broad field, energy spreading to many receivers at once. The dispersal is the point, not concentration, not aim. Something that lived in the space of patient receiving has found its way out into the world, scattering in multiple directions at once. The silent hospitality becomes a broadcast.

name: Arrival
coreSense: Diffuse open availability meeting a specific guest, the wide hospitality finds its particular recipient.
image: The channel has been open without object, general availability, wide and unfocused, the hospitality without guests. Now a guest has arrived. One source, one signal, requiring full attention, not many, not a flood of input from all directions. The wide aperture narrows to a single point of deep contact. Someone has walked into the open space and the openness is now entirely theirs. This is what the readiness was for, even if you didn't know who it was readiness for. The availability has found its focus.

name: Ignition
coreSense: Dormant open availability breaking into concentrated directed action, the deepest silence becomes the fullest signal.
image: Everything was silent. The channel was open in the most diffuse, least directed way, available to anything, holding nothing, aimed at nothing. Now the direction has reversed completely and the concentration has reached maximum: one target, one signal, all active energy going there. Nothing scattered, nothing held back. Whatever formed in the wide empty space has resolved into the clearest possible output, focused, outward, fully committed. The silence was real, and so is what breaks it. A long patient openness has become an entirely specific act.

name: Fallow
coreSense: Wide latent reach turning inward, the silent transmitter opens instead to whatever comes.
image: The capacity was there, pointed outward, a live transmitter with nothing to send, a network with no message queued. Now the orientation is shifting. The outward reach isn't firing. Instead the channel is turning around, opening wide to receive from anywhere. Just a broad inward availability replacing the broad outward reserve, no specific source, no focused attention. A field left unplanted to recover: the infrastructure stays real, the reach stays real, but right now nothing is going out. What held itself ready to broadcast is opening itself to be filled instead.

name: Reserve
coreSense: Wide latent reach holding steady, the capacity continues in reserve, neither activating nor releasing.
image: The transmitter is live. The reach is real. Nothing is being sent, and this continues. The stage stays set without a performance beginning. The network remains connected without traffic. There's no signal, no message, no target, just the maintained readiness of wide outward capacity held in reserve. A lighthouse that keeps its lamp trimmed through a night when no ships need it. The silence is kept, not empty. The capacity is held, not idle. This is what ongoing reserve looks like.

name: Bearing
coreSense: Wide diffuse reserve beginning to orient toward one specific source, the latent reach finds a direction to attend.
image: The channel has been silent and spread wide, reach available in every direction, nothing going out, no particular thing drawing attention. Something has started to shift. The open awareness is beginning to narrow, orienting toward one specific source, though no signal has arrived and no message is forming. A listener in a noisy room who goes still because something in one corner has become interesting. The wide silent reserve hasn't fired. It's starting to focus its attention on one particular frequency. Where everything was undirected, now one direction has weight. The capacity is beginning to listen.

name: Draw
coreSense: Wide diffuse reserve collapsing into a single pointed intention, broad capacity sharpening toward one target.
image: The reach was wide and silent, a transmitter with no message, capacity spread across many directions without any of them claiming it. Something is pulling it together now. The distribution is collapsing inward to a point: one target, one direction, the antenna swinging to align on something specific. The arrow hasn't left the bow yet. But where the capacity was scattered and undirected, it's now drawn back and aimed. The whole diffuse reserve is behind this one intended direction. The wide silence has become a specific readiness.

name: Canvass
coreSense: Silent outward reserve reversing into wide active intake, the held capacity opens to signal arriving from many directions.
image: The channel was live but silent, pointed outward with nothing to send. Now the direction has flipped: instead of a transmitter waiting for a message, a wide receiver is pulling in from everywhere at once. The shift is from one kind of readiness to its mirror image. What was ready to speak is now ready to listen, and not to one thing but to many. Data arriving from multiple directions, the field talking back. Reading the room after holding still long enough for people to start talking. The wide reach that was reserved for sending is now drawing in.

name: Release
coreSense: Latent outward capacity activating into wide sending, the reserve finds its signal and goes out.
image: The transmitter was live and the reach was real, but there was nothing to send. Now there is. The capacity held in reserve, the platform, the network, the wide potential audience, is being used. The signal is going out across the whole field at once, spreading to many receivers, not narrowed to one target or concentrated into a single message. The same broad reach that was silent is now active. A broadcast that finally begins after the equipment has been on and waiting. The stage has been set long enough. The performance starts. What was held is released into the wide open.

name: Mooring
coreSense: Wide diffuse reserve narrowing and reversing into deep focused reception, the broad silence settles into one specific source.
image: The reach was wide and going nowhere, a live transmitter with no message, distributed in all directions without landing anywhere. Something is pulling it to a point and turning it around. The broad outward capacity is becoming focused inward reception: one thing that now has full attention, not many sources, not a wide sweep. A boat that has been drifting in open water, suddenly finding the dock it didn't know it was heading for. The reserve anchors inward, to one specific source that is now claiming everything the channel has. The wide silence becomes a deep, specific listening.

name: Commission
coreSense: Wide latent reserve sharpening into concentrated directed action, all held capacity deployed toward one target.
image: The transmitter was live and silent, reach held wide, capacity distributed and unspent. Now the whole reserve is being collected and aimed at one specific place. The distributed capacity is collapsing into a single focused line from you to one target, with nothing scattered and nothing held back. The breadth of what STANDBY held doesn't scatter into broadcast. It narrows completely, sharpens to a point, and fires with the full force of everything that was waiting. A long unreleased capacity converted entirely into a single, concentrated act.

name: Aperture
coreSense: Pointed vigil releasing into wide, unfocused availability, the specific waiting opens into general readiness.
image: The attention has been held on one frequency, a particular source, a specific thing you've been watching for, the channel tuned and waiting. That focus is loosening now. No signal came, or something has shifted, and the tight, directed waiting is opening outward into a much wider state: available to anything, aimed at nothing in particular. The narrow aperture of the vigil is widening. A telescope lens pulled back until it's just a window. You're open again to whatever the field offers. The held attention doesn't collapse. It expands.

name: Threshold
coreSense: Focused inward vigil beginning to orient outward, the expectant waiting tilts toward latent reach.
image: The channel has been tuned inward, watching a particular source for something to arrive. The orientation is shifting now, but not yet into outward action, not yet toward a message to send. The attention that was pointed in is beginning to point out. The same capacity that was held in expectant vigil is becoming a kind of readiness to reach: a live transmitter with nothing queued yet, a platform not yet in use. Still no signal, still no move made, but the direction is different. Standing in a doorway between the silence of waiting and the wide open of potential reach.

name: Vigil
coreSense: Focused waiting holding steady, the expectant attention on one source continues without yet receiving.
image: The channel is tuned to one frequency and stays tuned. You're watching for something from a specific source, and the watching continues, the same posture, the same direction, the same pointed readiness. Nothing has arrived. The attention hasn't wavered. This is a state sustaining itself through time. A night watch that goes on through the dark hours without incident. The tuning is real, the attention costs something to hold, and it holds anyway. You are still here, still attending, still open to this one thing.

name: Pivot
coreSense: Focused inward vigil flipping to focused outward intention, the waiting becomes purpose.
image: The attention has been entirely inward, tuned to one source, watching for a signal to arrive from somewhere specific. Now the same focus is turning around, pointing in the opposite direction. The aimed intention is forming: one target, one direction, the antenna swung from receiving to transmitting mode. The vigil is becoming a vow. What you were waiting to receive has resolved into something you intend to do or say or give. The focus holds perfectly through this reversal. Only the direction changes. The arrow is nocked, pointing away from where it was pointed before.

name: Breach
coreSense: Focused closed vigil breaking open into wide active intake, the narrow wait flooded by signal from many directions.
image: The channel was tuned tight: one frequency, one source, expectant and held. Something has broken that focus open, and it wasn't the signal you were waiting for. Input is arriving now from many directions at once, the whole spectrum suddenly active, and the narrow channel of the vigil can't contain it. A floodgate releasing: the pointed, patient waiting is overwhelmed by broad incoming signal. Nothing is being sorted yet. The value right now is in what's arriving, in the breadth of it. The specific source you were watching hasn't appeared, but the field has answered differently, and abundantly.

name: Exhale
coreSense: Inward focused vigil reversing into wide outward sending, the held attention breathes out across a broad field.
image: The channel was turned entirely inward, tuned to one source, closed to everything else, holding itself in expectant silence. Now the direction reverses and the focus dissolves at once: energy is moving outward, spreading across many receivers, diffusing into a field. The dispersal is deliberate. What was gathered inward in the vigil is releasing outward without fixing on any single target. An intake held for a long time, finally let go as a wide breath. The closed, pointed watching opens into something that moves in all directions at once. The held-in becomes broadcast.

name: Answer
coreSense: Focused vigil met by the signal it was waiting for, the expectant watching becomes deep reception.
image: The channel was tuned to one source and waiting. Now something is arriving, not from everywhere, not a flood of data from many directions, but from the specific source the attention was held on. The vigil is paying off. The same focused inward posture that was expectant is now receiving: the channel that was held ready is carrying signal at last. A listener who has been silent for a long time, finally hearing the voice they've been listening for. The tuning required patience. The reception requires the same quality of attention. The waiting and the receiving are continuous, one held state finally finding its completion.

name: Return
coreSense: Focused inward vigil converting into focused outward action, the waiting becomes sending, attention becomes commitment.
image: The channel was tuned to receive from one source, held in patient attention, closed to everything else. Now the same focus is still there, the same point-to-point quality, but the direction has flipped completely. Energy is moving outward, to one specific target, carrying everything it has. The concentration of the vigil has become the concentration of the act, nothing scattered, nothing diffuse. What was waiting to be given to you is now being given by you. The inward held-open quality of TUNE returns as the outward full-commitment of TRANSMIT, the same depth, the same singularity, flowing now in the other direction.

name: Prospect
coreSense: Focused outward intention releasing into wide, unfocused availability, the aimed purpose opens into patient receptivity.
image: The intention was clear and pointed: one target, the antenna aligned, the signal held back but ready. That sharp direction is loosening now. The channel never fired, but the focus itself is dissolving, the aimed stance giving way to something wider and more open. What was locked onto one specific thing is opening outward into general availability, no particular source, no particular target, just a broad silent readiness to whatever the field offers. A hunter who has spent hours watching one spot and finally lowers the bow and simply looks at the whole landscape. The intention was real. The opening is too.

name: Poise
coreSense: One held intention joined by a second latent capacity, focused readiness doubled, still nothing sent.
image: The intention is already aimed: one target, everything pointed, the signal ready but withheld. Now something else is coming online alongside it, not a second aim, but a different kind of reserve: wide outward capacity, a platform held live, reach in many directions without a message to send. Two forms of readiness accumulating at once, neither breaking into action. An archer whose quiver is full and whose path ahead is clear, waiting for the right moment on both counts. The stillness is loaded. Nothing is going out, but what's held here is a paired capacity, focused and broad both, everything in reserve.

name: Inversion
coreSense: Focused outward intention becoming focused inward vigil, the aimed channel turns around.
image: The aim was outward: one target, intention locked, the antenna pointed and ready to send. Now the same focused, point-to-point quality is being maintained, but the direction is reversing. The outward aim is becoming an inward attention. Instead of a signal ready to go to one specific place, there is now a silence held on one specific source, waiting for something to arrive from it. The focus doesn't break. It turns. A transmitter swinging around to become a receiver, locked on the same single frequency it was aiming at, now listening instead of poised to speak. The precision is the same. The direction is not.

name: Brace
coreSense: Held intention meeting more held intention, focused readiness persisting without releasing.
image: The intention was already formed and aimed. It stays. The channel is pointed at one target, signal withheld, the nocked arrow still nocked, and this continues. The holding is itself the state. A second AIM doesn't fire the first. It deepens the same posture. This is what sustained, deliberate withholding feels like: a clear-eyed holding of something specific in readiness, without the moment having arrived to release it. The tension is maintained on purpose. The direction hasn't changed. Neither has the decision not to act yet.

name: Survey
coreSense: Focused outward intention loosening into wide active intake, the single aim gives way to broad gathering.
image: The intention was fixed on one target: aimed, specific, ready. Something in that has shifted. The focus is releasing, not into another aim, but into something much wider. Input is arriving from many directions now, the channel open to the whole field rather than locked onto one point. The signal that was ready to go hasn't gone. Instead, the posture has reversed from aimed-outward to wide-inward, pulling in from everywhere at once rather than pointing out. Stepping back from the scope to look at the whole terrain. The aim hasn't fired. The field has spoken first, and there's more here than the single target suggested.

name: Scatter
coreSense: Focused intention dispersing into wide outward sending, the single aimed purpose breaks open across a broad field.
image: The intention was pointed at one place. Now the energy is going out, but not to that one place, to many places at once, spreading wide, reaching across a broad field of receivers without concentrating on any single one of them. The precise aim has dissolved into something far more diffuse. The signal is going out, the outward direction is real, but the specificity is gone. A stone that was set in a sling to hit one mark, released instead into water, sending rings in every direction. Whether this is the aim abandoned or the aim enlarged is hard to say. What was held for one becomes available to many.

name: Yield
coreSense: Outward focused intention reversing into inward focused reception, the readiness to give becomes openness to receive.
image: The channel was aimed outward at one specific target, intention held, signal ready, nothing sent yet. Now the direction is reversing entirely, and the focus is holding. The same point-to-point precision that was aimed at one place is now turned around, open to receive from one source. A clean reversal of direction while the concentration stays intact, not a scattering, not a widening. What was a readiness to give is becoming a readiness to take in. The arrow undrawn, the bow turned around, the same stillness, the same specific single point of contact, but now the energy moves toward you rather than away. A prepared offering that becomes instead a prepared receiving.

name: Dispatch
coreSense: Held intention finally releasing into full concentrated action, the nocked arrow loosed at last.
image: The intention was formed, the target was clear, the channel was aimed and ready and not yet firing. Now it fires. The signal that was held goes out to one specific place, at full concentration, nothing scattered, nothing withheld. This is the direct completion of AIM: the latent becoming active, the closed channel opening, the arrow finally leaving the bow. What was readiness has become act. The quality of the focus hasn't changed, still one target, still everything pointed in that direction, but the channel is open now and carrying everything it has. The held becomes given. The aimed becomes sent.

name: Lull
coreSense: Wide active intake settling into wide passive availability, the busy scan goes silent without closing.
image: The channel has been pulling in from everywhere, signals arriving from many directions, the field talking all at once, a wide and busy reception. That activity is stilling now. The breadth stays. The intake eases. What was active gathering is becoming a kind of patient openness: available to whatever arrives, no longer sweeping or sorting, simply present to the field without demanding that it produce. The same wide aperture that was working hard is now resting. A researcher who has been reading all morning, setting down the last paper and sitting open-eyed with no particular text in hand. The information-gathering phase has passed. The wide readiness that follows is its own kind of attention.

name: Crest
coreSense: Wide active intake shifting toward wide latent reach, the gathered field turns the channel toward readiness to send.
image: The channel has been pulling in widely, reading the room, sampling the field, taking in signal from many directions without yet committing to any of it. Something in all that gathering has reached a turning point. The intake isn't reversing yet. Nothing is going out. But the orientation is tilting: a broad outward capacity is coming online, a platform readying itself, reach in many directions held live without a message yet to send. The wave that has been building from all that input is at its peak before it moves. What was drawn in is about to become something ready to send out, held, spread wide, the means of broadcast prepared and waiting for the signal to form.

name: Catch
coreSense: Wide active intake narrowing to focused expectant vigil, something in the scan has claimed the whole attention.
image: The channel was sweeping broadly, many sources, wide intake, the whole field sampled without filtering. Then something snagged. One frequency in the broad reception has become interesting in a way the others haven't, and the wide sweep is contracting around it: no signal from it yet, but the attention is narrowing, the antenna swinging to hold this one direction. The scanner becoming a receiver pointed at one source. What happens next, whether anything arrives, isn't settled. But the searching phase is over for now. A bird-watcher who has been scanning the treeline and suddenly freezes, glass trained on one branch, waiting to see if what they glimpsed was really there.

name: Elect
coreSense: Wide active intake resolving into single focused intention, the broad gathering selects one target and commits.
image: The channel was open to everything, input from many directions, the field surveyed, nothing filtered out yet. Now a choice is crystallizing from all that material. The breadth is collapsing into a point: one target, the antenna swinging from a wide sweep to a fixed aim. This is still the latent posture, the intention formed but the action not yet taken, and out of everything the scan found, one thing has been selected. The research phase closing, the decision made. A scout who has spent time reading the terrain and now marks one specific location on the map. All that wide gathering was in service of this one committed direction.

name: Sweep
coreSense: Wide active intake continuing, the broad gathering sustains itself through time.
image: The channel is open and pulling in from many directions, and it stays that way. Input keeps arriving from the whole field, nothing filtered, nothing committed to, the breadth maintained deliberately. This is a sustained scan: not a momentary survey before settling on something, but a genuine ongoing state of wide intake. More arrives, is taken in, held loosely, and the channel stays open for more. A physician doing rounds, a naturalist in the field for days, someone in the middle of a long research phase who hasn't yet found the thing that will redirect them. The value is in the accumulation and the continued openness, not in resolution. Nothing needs to narrow yet.

name: Relay
coreSense: Wide active intake reversing into wide active sending, what was gathered from many sources goes back out to many receivers.
image: The channel has been drawing in from across the field, many sources, wide reception, the full spectrum sampled. Now the direction is flipping while the breadth holds. What was coming in across a wide front is now going out across a wide front: energy spreading outward to many receivers, the signal distributed rather than concentrated. The same dispersal that characterized the intake now characterizes the output, nothing focused, nothing aimed at one place. A hub that collects from many inputs and routes to many outputs without collapsing the plurality on either side. The gathered field becomes a transmitted field. What was received from many is passed on to many.

name: Landing
coreSense: Wide active intake narrowing into deep focused reception, the broad scan settles at last on one source.
image: The channel has been wide open, sweeping the spectrum, pulling in from many directions, everything sampled and nothing yet claimed. Something is claiming it now. The broad intake is contracting around one source: the attention narrowing, the channel focusing, until only one thing is coming in and coming in fully. The scan has found what it was scanning for, or what it needed without knowing it. A long aerial survey that finally puts down its wheels. What was distributed and restless becomes deep and still on one particular frequency. The gathering is over. The listening is beginning. Whatever this source is carrying, the channel is now entirely open to it, concentrated and unhurried.

name: Distill
coreSense: Wide active intake resolving into concentrated outward action, the broad gathering becomes a single aimed signal.
image: The channel has been drawing in from everywhere, a wide, busy reception, the whole field sampled, many sources contributing to a growing body of intake. Now all of that is being converted into something pointed and outward. A single focused line to one specific target, carrying the concentrated essence of everything that was taken in, not a broadcast, not a wide dispersal. The breadth of the scan has been processed down to one clear signal. A long research phase ending not in a scattered report but in a single precise act: the thing to say, said once, to the one person or place it needs to reach. Wide intake becomes narrow output, and the output is the stronger for what fed it.

name: Echo
coreSense: Wide active sending settling into wide passive availability, the broadcast goes silent without closing.
image: The channel has been sending outward in all directions, signal reaching across a broad field, energy distributed to many receivers at once. That outward motion is stilling now. The breadth stays. The sending eases. What was active and diffuse is becoming a different kind of open: available to whatever comes back, not aimed at anything, no longer pushing signal out. The same wide aperture that was transmitting is now simply present to the field. A speaker who has said what they had to say and goes silent, still in the room, still open to whatever the room holds. The broadcast is over. The listening has not yet begun, but the space for it is real.

name: Recess
coreSense: Wide active sending pulling back into wide latent reserve, the broadcast goes silent but keeps its reach.
image: The channel has been sending across a broad field, many receivers, diffuse signal, energy spread outward in all directions. Now the sending is stopping, but the reach isn't going away. What was a live broadcast is becoming a live silence: the same wide-open capacity held ready, the same platform, the same network, just nothing going out through it anymore. The transmitter stays on. The tower stays up. The audience could still receive, but nothing is being sent to them right now. A show that has gone to intermission without canceling the broadcast. The capacity for wide reach is maintained in its entirety. Only the message has paused.

name: Gather
coreSense: Wide outward sending narrowing into focused inward vigil, the broadcast contracts to watch one specific thing.
image: The channel has been open and sending wide, diffuse, outward, reaching many places at once. Something in all that outward motion is changing direction. The breadth is contracting and the posture is reversing: no longer sending outward in every direction, but narrowing to hold one frequency, inward, watching for something specific to arrive. The broadcast that was scattering seed in all directions is becoming a careful attention to one particular place. Nothing has arrived yet. The vigil is just forming. Where there was dispersal, there is now focus. Where there was outward motion, there is now inward readiness. The wide field has produced one thing worth waiting on.

name: Tether
coreSense: Wide diffuse sending collapsing into single focused intention, the broadcast finds its one real target.
image: The signal has been going out to many receivers at once, scattered across a wide field, no single point claimed more than any other. Now the distribution is pulling inward toward one specific place. The energy that was spread across the whole field is being collected and aimed: an intention forming with one clear target, the signal not yet sent. The many have resolved into the one. Something in the broadcast has named a destination. The channel is closing down to a held aim, a deliberate withholding in a specific direction, and the direction is now exact. What went wide is finding where it actually needs to go.

name: Upturn
coreSense: Wide outward sending reversing into wide inward intake, the direction flips while the breadth holds.
image: The channel was sending outward to a wide field, signal out to many receivers, energy distributed in all directions. Now the direction is reversing, and the breadth is holding. Instead of sending widely, the channel is pulling in widely: input arriving from many sources at once, the full spectrum sampled, the same distributed posture now turned inward. Nothing is filtered yet, nothing committed to, just the broad intake, everything the field has to offer suddenly arriving. The tide that was going out is now coming in across the same wide front. The broadcast that was pushing outward opens into a gathering that pulls inward. What was given to many is now being received from many.

name: Radiance
coreSense: Wide active sending holding steady, the broadcast continues across a broad field.
image: The channel is open and sending outward to many receivers, and it stays that way. No narrowing, no pulling back, no reversal, just the same diffuse outward energy sustaining itself through time. Signal keeps going out across the wide field. The distribution is maintained. This is a broadcast that has found its rhythm and continues: not a moment of release before something else, but a genuine ongoing state of wide, open sending. A radio tower that has been transmitting all morning and will transmit all afternoon. An idea moving through a network, reaching people it won't even know it reached. The energy is going out. It has been going out. It continues to go out.

name: Attend
coreSense: Wide outward sending narrowing and reversing into deep focused reception, the broadcast gives way to one specific source.
image: The channel has been sending in many directions at once, diffuse, outward, reaching a broad field without concentrating on any part of it. Something is drawing it in. The wide dispersal is contracting and reversing: not just narrowing to one point but turning around, so that instead of sending outward to many, the channel is now fully open to one source in particular. Deep reception, focused, nothing else coming in or going out. The one who has been speaking to a crowd turns to listen to one voice in it. The broadcast that was for everyone becomes the attention that is entirely for one. Nothing of the wide sending was wasted. This is where it brings you.

name: Forge
coreSense: Wide diffuse sending concentrating into full directed action, the broadcast sharpens into one committed line.
image: The channel has been sending across a wide field, signal reaching many receivers at once, energy spread outward without fixing on any single one. Now all of that is being gathered into a single line. The distribution collapses, the breadth drops away, and what remains is concentrated and aimed: one target, one signal, everything going there at full strength. Nothing scattered now, nothing spread thin. The same outward energy that was broadcast to many has been forged into something precise. The wide reach was real. So is the focused act it becomes. What was available to anyone is now fully committed to one specific place, one specific receiver, with everything behind it.

name: Soften
coreSense: Deep focused reception easing into wide, unfocused availability, the close listening opens into general readiness.
image: The channel has been entirely given to one source: one person, one text, one experience, fully received. That depth is loosening now. The close, committed listening is opening out, not closing, not pulling back, but widening. The single source that held all the attention is releasing it into something more diffuse: available to whatever comes, aimed at nothing in particular, the whole field open again. A reader who sets down a book they've been deep inside and sits silently in the room, open to whatever the room holds. The reception doesn't end. It expands. The fullness of what was taken in is still present, now held in a wider, stiller space.

name: Surface
coreSense: Deep inward reception beginning to orient outward, the focused listening starts turning toward latent reach.
image: The channel has been fully open to one source, close, committed reception, all attention given to what was coming in. Something in that deep receiving is beginning to shift direction. The posture is tilting, the inward focus loosening and the outward capacity coming online, though no reversal has happened yet and no message has formed. Wide reach is becoming available, a platform, a network, many potential receivers, held live but still silent. What was received hasn't been sent yet. The sending capacity hasn't been used. But the one who was listening is beginning to look up. The deep intake is finding its way toward a readiness to speak, or reach, or offer something back out.

name: Linger
coreSense: Active deep reception becoming expectant vigil, the signal fades and the channel holds, waiting.
image: The channel has been receiving from one source: something was arriving, coming in fully, held with complete attention. Now the signal is thinning. The attention is still pointed in the same direction, still focused on the same source, but the active reception is becoming a waiting. The source has gone silent for now, and the channel stays open on that frequency, expecting more, not yet willing to move on. A conversation that has paused but hasn't ended: both people still present, still oriented toward each other, the silence between them alive. The focused inward quality doesn't change. Only the arrival has stopped, and the channel holds its attention there anyway, patient, watching for what comes next.

name: Turning
coreSense: Focused inward reception reversing to focused outward intention, what was taken in is becoming something to give.
image: The channel has been fully open inward, receiving from one source, close attention, everything coming in. Now the same focused, point-to-point quality is being maintained, but the direction is pivoting. The deep reception is becoming a held intention: the antenna swinging from receive to transmit mode, still aimed at the same single frequency, now poised to send rather than take in. The intention is forming, the vow taking shape, the nocked arrow, with no signal going yet. What was given to you is becoming something you're preparing to give back or pass on. The receiving has been converted into a specific readiness. The listening is ending. The response is about to begin.

name: Widen
coreSense: Deep focused reception opening into wide active intake, the single source gives way to many.
image: The channel has been trained on one source: deep, focused, nothing else coming in. Something is expanding now. The single point of reception is spreading outward, not closing, but losing its singularity, opening to pull in from many directions at once. Input is arriving from across the field, many sources at once, the broad sweep of signal that a scan provides. What required full attention to one thing is becoming a wide and busy gathering. A student who has spent months with one teacher and is suddenly in the library, reading everything. The focused depth has become a foundation for the widening. What was received from one is now being multiplied by everything the whole field has to add.

name: Offering
coreSense: Deep focused inward reception reversing into wide outward sending, what was taken in is released to many.
image: The channel has been entirely inward, one source, full attention, deep reception. Now the direction reverses and the focus dissolves together: energy is moving outward, and not to one specific place but to many receivers at once. The close, concentrated receiving is becoming a diffuse, open sending. What came in through a narrow, specific channel goes out through a wide, open one. Nothing is held back, and nothing is aimed precisely either. The signal spreads across the field, reaching whoever is there to receive it. Someone who has listened carefully to one person for a long time and then turns to speak to a crowd. The depth of the intake becomes the energy of the broadcast.

name: Immersion
coreSense: Deep focused reception holding steady, the close, committed listening sustains itself through time.
image: The channel is fully open to one source and stays that way. One person, one work, one experience, and the attention remains entirely given to it. Nothing is narrowing further. Nothing is widening or shifting direction. The same depth of reception that was present at the start is present now and continues to be present. A long conversation that keeps going deeper rather than concluding. A text you have been inside for days, still finding more. The care required to receive fully hasn't lessened. Neither has the commitment to keep receiving. This is what sustained, unbroken attention to one source looks and feels like, not arrival, not departure, just the ongoing state of being completely open to what one specific thing keeps offering.

name: Passage
coreSense: Deep focused reception becoming full concentrated action, the taken-in becomes the given-out.
image: The channel has been entirely open to one source, close, committed, patient reception, everything coming in. Now the same focus, the same point-to-point quality, the same total commitment, and the direction has reversed completely. Energy is moving outward to one specific place, carrying everything the channel has, nothing scattered or withheld. The deep intake has become a deep output. What was received is being transmitted: not broadcast to many, not lost in diffusion, but sent with the same singularity and care with which it was received. Someone who has listened fully to one person and now speaks fully in return. The quality of the attention is unchanged. Only the direction of its motion is different.

name: Repose
coreSense: Concentrated outward sending releasing into wide, passive availability, the focused effort opens into rest.
image: The channel has been running at full output: one target, all active energy going there, nothing scattered, nothing withheld. That intensity is easing now, not switching to another target, not widening to broadcast, just opening. The directional, focused sending is releasing into something diffuse and still: available to whatever arrives, aimed at nothing, no message queued. A craftsperson who has been working a single piece all day, finally setting down the tools and sitting open-handed in the last of the light. The effort was real. So is the opening that follows it. The channel doesn't close. It widens into a different kind of presence.

name: Interval
coreSense: Concentrated outward sending pulling back into wide latent reserve, the focused signal pauses but the reach stays live.
image: The channel has been carrying signal to one specific place at full concentration. Now the signal is stopping, but the infrastructure isn't going away. The focused transmission is converting into a different kind of readiness: broad outward capacity, alive and available, no message currently queued, no single target in the sights. The precision of what was being sent is releasing into something distributed and held. The antenna comes down from its locked aim and sweeps back across a wide horizon, live but silent. A surgeon who has finished one procedure and is still scrubbed in, available, having not yet turned to the next case. The reach is intact. The work is paused.

name: Spend
coreSense: Concentrated outward sending shifting into focused inward vigil, the giving becomes a waiting.
image: The channel has been sending fully to one place: all active energy, one direction, nothing held back. Now the same point-to-point quality is holding, but the direction is turning. No more signal going out. Instead the channel is held open in a different way: tuned to one source, expectant, watching for something to come in. The intense outward commitment is becoming an equally intense inward attention. A conversation where you have said everything you had to say and now go silent, listening for what comes back. The focus hasn't changed, and neither has the singularity. Only the movement has reversed, from full giving to full waiting, concentrated all the way through.

name: Sustain
coreSense: Concentrated outward sending converting to focused outward intention, the act becomes a held readiness.
image: The channel has been at full output: one target, everything going there, open and committed. Now the signal pauses, but the direction stays fixed. The full active sending is becoming a held intention: the antenna still pointed at the same place, the connection still real, but the channel has gone silent. Still aimed, still specific, still capable of carrying signal, just not carrying it right now. A long and demanding correspondence that enters a considered pause, both parties still in it, neither having moved on. The work isn't over. The direction hasn't changed. What was fully enacted is now fully held, poised in the same precise direction, waiting for the next thing to give.

name: Harvest
coreSense: Concentrated outward sending reversing into wide active intake, the focused giving opens into broad gathering.
image: The channel has been running one direction at full force: one target, everything concentrated outward. Now the direction is reversing and the focus is dissolving together. Instead of sending to one, the channel is pulling in from many: signal arriving from across the field, many sources at once, the wide sweep of an open intake. The sharp, committed outward act is becoming a broad, open receiving. A teacher who has spent weeks pouring themselves into one student and now walks through a library, reading widely, letting the field offer what it has. The concentrated giving is over for now. The wide, unhurried gathering has begun. What went out precisely is being replenished from everywhere.

name: Diffuse
coreSense: Concentrated point-to-point sending widening into diffuse outward broadcast, the precise signal releases across a broad field.
image: The channel has been locked on one target: focused, outward, fully committed to one specific place. Now the focus is releasing while the outward direction holds. The same energy that was going to one receiver is spreading out to many, signal distributed across a wide field, reaching many at once, none of them getting the concentrated dose the single target was getting. The precise line opens wide. A letter written to one person turned into a pamphlet. Whether something is gained in the widening or lost in the dilution depends on what the situation needed, but the release is real, and the energy is moving outward, which is what it was doing before. The aim has opened. The field is receiving what was being held for one.

name: Exchange
coreSense: Concentrated outward sending reversing into concentrated inward reception, the giving becomes an equally deep taking-in.
image: The channel has been entirely outward: one specific target, full concentration, nothing held back, everything going there. Now the direction is reversing while the focus holds perfectly. The same point-to-point quality, the same singularity, the same total commitment, but the energy is no longer going out. It's coming in, from one source, received fully. The one who has been giving with complete concentration turns to receive with the same quality of attention. Nothing diffused, nothing scattered, nothing redirected. What changes is only the direction of motion. A conversation that has reached the point where the speaker becomes the listener, without anything loosening in the depth of the contact between them.

name: Confluence
coreSense: Concentrated outward sending persisting, the focused act continues with everything it has.
image: The channel is at full output and stays there. One target, all active energy going there, nothing scattered, nothing withheld, and this continues. Not a pause before something different, not a peak about to break, but a sustained state of total directed commitment that is holding its own. Two rivers joining and running on as one, stronger than either was separately. Whatever this work is, it has all of you and it keeps having all of you. The channel is open, the focus is exact, the giving is complete, and tomorrow it is the same. This is what it looks like when the most active, most committed posture a channel can take is not a momentary intensity but a way of being in this situation right now.
